items: GET /api/changelog endpoint serving this file for in-app release notes [NEEDS_DOCS]
Tooltips and info icons on every dashboard widget, stat card, table column header, and device detail modal — all panels now self-documenting for NOC operators [NEEDS_DOCS]
Changelog viewer — in-app release notes accessible from the nav bar
Viewport-aware tooltip positioning: tooltips now clamp to screen edges using React portal + useLayoutEffect, preventing cut-off near left/right edges

Background LLM back-fill worker: continuously finds tenants with missing AI analysis and processes them rate-limited (asyncio.Semaphore(2), 3s between devices, 8s between tenants) to avoid overloading the vLLM endpoint
GET /api/ai/stats endpoint: exposes queue depth, 24h completion count, session totals, rolling latency stats (avg/P95/min/max over last 100 calls), cache hit rate, and current job identity

AI Analysis Engine panel on leaderboard landing page: live LLM worker stats with 5-second polling — status indicator, current job banner, queue depth, session totals, latency breakdown, and cache hit rate progress bar
Standalone Customer CVE Analyzer: full multi-tenant NetBox CVE scanning service built on FastAPI with SQLite (WAL mode) for persistent scan history
Global scan: deduplicated NVD API queries across all tenants via combo_map — devices sharing identical platform+version share one API call, reducing NVD load significantly
Per-tenant and global scan endpoints with Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming — results appear in the dashboard in real time as each device is processed
Excel export (per-tenant and all tenants): styled workbook with CVE score color-coding (red ≥ 9.0, orange ≥ 7.0, yellow ≥ 4.0), frozen header row, auto column widths
Leaderboard endpoint with estate-wide aggregates: total counts, vulnerable/critical device tallies, top CVEs by device count, severity breakdown, platform exposure rankings
Capture serial number, PON (cmd_pon custom field), platform name, and OS version from NetBox for each device and VM
LLM estate summary with risk posture, trend comparison, top CVEs, and prioritized remediation recommendations — generated per tenant after each scan completes
Per-device LLM security assessment stored alongside CVE data and streamed to the dashboard
Fix startup crash: CREATE INDEX for platform_name column was running inside executescript before the ALTER TABLE migration — moved index creation to after the migration loop
Fix Excel export: strip XML-illegal control characters (ASCII 0x00-0x08, 0x0b-0x0c, 0x0e-0x1f) from NetBox strings using regex sanitizer before writing cells
Export filtered to only include devices with CVE score > 0 — clean devices excluded
Standalone Customer CVE Analyzer SPA: dark-themed, monospace NOC dashboard replacing the original embedded NetBox CVE view

Leaderboard landing page: estate overview stat cards, customer risk rankings table (sortable/filterable), severity breakdown bar chart, top platforms by exposure, most widespread CVEs across all tenants
GlobalScanPanel in nav bar: trigger an estate-wide scan and monitor live progress — inventory counts, platform analysis, NVD query queue, results, and phase timing all update in real time via SSE
Tenant selector with debounced search, has-devices filter, stale cache age indicators, and recently-scanned list
SSE streaming in tenant view: device rows stream in and sort by severity score in real time as the scan progresses — most critical devices always visible first
Per-tenant Excel export button in tenant view header
Export All button on leaderboard to download every vulnerable device across every tenant in one workbook
